svg.text: Candidate B -- Unlit gap punched through the fill
All colours are layout placeholders, not chosen values -- pending measurement against the panel.
State 1 -- usage ~20%, clock marker AHEAD of the fill (in the unlit region)
(dotted outline = wireframe annotation only; invisible-in-practice on the real panel)
State 2 -- usage ~85%, clock marker BEHIND the fill edge (inside the lit region)
State 3 -- usage ~85%, mascot silhouette overlapping the rail: no halo (left) vs 1px knockout halo (right)
no halo -- mascot's ears sit directly on the fill
halo -- 1px dilation cleared under the ears first
